name: Kutirjyoti Yojana Gujarat
benefit: - Free electricity household connection is provided to BPL/lower income group beneficiary.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant should be living in a tribal area of the state. 1. The applicant’s family should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) or lower-income group category. 1. The applicant’s family annual income should not exceed ₹1,50,000/-. 1. The applicant should own land or a house under a poverty housing scheme or through land allotment.
